note: Constraints (must not break the build/production probe, must not destroy verified work, safety-preserving) bound this pass to the surgical, regression-safe subset. Two findings (008, 016) were IMPLEMENTED then REVERTED after they broke the production probe / the injected-critic test-double corpus respectively; they are recorded open with the exact one-line fix and the test-corpus migration each requires. FINAL CONTAINMENT (this commit (`fix(safety): quarantine autonomous promotion by default`)): because the Critical finding 001 remains architecturally OPEN, autonomous promotion is now DISABLED BY DEFAULT for every strategy at the canonical authority and refuses under gate-wall bypass — Ikbi is safe for operator-reviewed work (manual /apply) but NOT for unattended autonomous promotion. This is operational containment, not a fix; 001 remains open. Full suite green (3861/0/1); production probe (autonomous enabled, bypass false) 111/111 at containment HEAD (this commit).

findings.title: Test evidence is not bound to the exact immutable promotion subject
findings.remainingLimitation: STILL OPEN (not fixed). The underlying architecture (freeze/commit BEFORE final verification, run tests+semantic against the frozen subject, mandatory-snapshot for every git-backed autonomous strategy, production lease wiring, snapshot-into-WorkspaceManager.promote) is NOT implemented and cannot land without breaking the production probe + every strategy integration test. OPERATIONAL CONTAINMENT (this commit (`fix(safety): quarantine autonomous promotion by default`)): autonomous promotion is now DISABLED BY DEFAULT at the canonical promoteCandidate authority for every strategy, and refuses when gate-wall bypass is active — so an unattended autonomous land of a possibly-non-immutable subject cannot occur by default. Manual /apply (manual-unverified, operator-reviewed) remains available. This containment does NOT establish the immutable-subject invariant; it prevents unattended promotion while it is open. Phase 13 protections (MutationFence + stale-tree + CAS + normal-mode physical snapshot) also remain in force.

findings.title: Provider-attempt journaling is post-terminal, not pre-dispatch or universal
findings.remainingLimitation: Requires moving the append-before-dispatch/finalize-after-terminal into the FROZEN-CORE ProviderInvoker per route, and routing classifier/consult through it. Frozen-core change + high blast radius; not landed.

findings.title: Cost and composite totals are not fully reconcilable across production operations
findings.remainingLimitation: Requires known-subtotal retention in cost() when partial, executedIds() including thrown charged records, and a production parent-operation ledger wired into duel/tournament/competitive/multi-step/CLI-cognition. The surgical cost/executedIds bits touch tested ledger accounting; deferred to avoid ledger-test blast radius. Duel composite (Phase 14B) remains the only production-wired composite.

findings.title: Receipt and aggregate execution identity can disagree with invocation/attempt truth
findings.remainingLimitation: Requires passing immutable invocation/evaluation objects (not lastFor/string IDs) + a pre-append reconciler. Large cross-cutting change; not landed. Phase 11C/12 happy-path linkage remains.

findings.title: Omitted or misdeclared category can turn unsupported style preference into a blocker
findings.remainingLimitation: A deterministic style-claim detector forces any style/formatting/naming/architecture-preference claim through the explicit-style-policy rule regardless of declared/omitted/mislabeled category. Whole-goal req:goal remains contextual (documented). Non-style categoryless defects still validate through the default rule — the audit's 'make category mandatory for ALL blockers' is stricter and would require migrating the Phase 12/15 categoryless-defect test corpus.

findings.title: Recovery can still change requirement association, category, binding presence, and verdict authority
findings.remainingLimitation: CLOSED: category removal (non-null->null) and unknown/indeterminate->blocking polarity recovery. RESIDUAL (accepted/documented): req:goal whole-goal-default addition (contextual, authorizes no blocker alone) and free-text requirement presence add/remove (noisy; Phase 15's requirementId presence tracking is the authority-bearing check). Full canonical-tuple presence equality would require also making req:goal non-authorizing, which cascades to the categoryless-defect test corpus.

findings.title: Gate bypass trust suppression is strategy-dependent
findings.remainingLimitation: Requires making gate authority a required field of every strategy result and every strategy trust reducer to suppress on administratively-bypassed. Normal mode already suppresses + labels; competitive/tournament reducers do not. Deferred to avoid competitive/tournament trust-test blast radius.

findings.title: Default identity resolver can classify a path/access error as proven non-Git
findings.remainingLimitation: IMPLEMENTED (existing-accessible-dir-only non-git classification) then REVERTED: it made the production probe's non-existent fake workspace paths (`/repo`) indeterminate, breaking 58 promotion/tournament/competitive tests including the sacred 111/111 probe. The correct fix (only an existing accessible dir with 'not a git repository' proves non-git) is a one-regex change but requires migrating the entire in-memory-workspace test corpus to use real accessible dirs. Not safely landable in this pass.

findings.title: Production tournament shadow replay remains self-denied
findings.remainingLimitation: defaultApplyDiff sends `git apply` through the model-command policy that denies `apply`. Requires a typed internal shadow-replay capability outside model-command authority (validated patch, path-contained, traversal-protected, receipted). Not attempted; tournament autonomous mode should be treated as quarantined until this lands.

findings.title: Runtime-truth scope and repair evidence propagation remain incomplete
findings.remainingLimitation: scopeMismatch checks a partial tuple and accepts absent optional bindings; repair paths do not uniformly request fresh evidence. Requires a mandatory immutable scope tuple + fresh-package-after-mutation. Not landed. Runtime truth remains advisory.

findings.title: Multi-step handoff remains labels rather than build evidence
findings.remainingLimitation: runOneAttempt records completedSteps as labels and drops prior-stage evidence/cost from the finalizer + parent total. Requires a typed immutable handoff. Not landed.

findings.title: Memory/protected-path governance is not universal across mutation channels
findings.remainingLimitation: The tool governor covers its enumerated tool path; there is no final whole-diff protected-path rescan before freeze/promotion. Requires a deterministic final candidate-delta scan in promoteCandidate. Not landed.

findings.title: Displayed test evidence depends on the verifier check being named exactly 'test'
findings.remainingLimitation: readVerifier now recognizes executed-test evidence by typed check kind (unit-test/integration-test/repository-test/executed-test) and typecheck by kind, in addition to the display name. Backward compatible. (The verifier does not YET STAMP these kinds on its checks by default — the reader honors them when present; stamping typed kinds at the verifier is a follow-on.)

findings.title: Success trust can still be recorded without promotion in the lower-tier terminal
findings.remainingLimitation: The verified-but-not-landed sub-trusted terminal records recordBuildTrust('success'). Distinguishing verified-workspace-success from governed-landed-success requires a core trust-schema change (src/core/trust). Low severity, trust ladder off by default. Deferred to avoid a core-trust change late in the pass.

findings.title: Manual apply authority labeling remains non-atomic
findings.remainingLimitation: The manual receipt already carries authorityMode:'manual-unverified' but as a SECONDARY best-effort record whose append failure is swallowed. Full atomicity requires the core WorkspaceManager.promote receipt to carry the authority class + surfacing a post-land receipt failure as audit-incomplete. Not landed.

findings.title: An unenforced no-package fail can still authorize the critic fixer
findings.remainingLimitation: IMPLEMENTED (isRetryableCriticFail -> effectiveDecisionKind) then REVERTED: it broke ~30 injected-critic test doubles that stamp a `fail` semanticVerdict WITHOUT evidenceEnforced and rely on the fixer firing. The duel/promotion decision gates ALREADY downgrade a no-package fail (effectiveDecisionKind); only the fix-loop trigger checks raw kind. The correct fix requires migrating the injected-critic double corpus to carry evidenceEnforced (or a non-production marker), which the audit itself recommends but is out of safe scope here.

findings.title: Physical snapshot cleanup is not protected by a finally boundary
findings.remainingLimitation: CLOSED: the primary leak — a throw from promoteCandidate (its mandatory receipt appends / workspaces.promote) after a real snapshot is created now cleans the detached worktree and surfaces a cleanup failure via worker.promotion.snapshot_cleanup_incomplete. RESIDUAL: a full try/finally owning the snapshot across EVERY exceptional exit (semantic-withheld/stale-tree receipt throws before the promote call) — the dominant throw source (promoteCandidate) is covered. No retained integration test injects the throw yet (documented).
